step_by_step_reasoning: The analysis began by identifying all distinct AWS services and external actors from the whiteboard diagram and correlating them with the transcript for exact naming and context. Nodes such as ECS, AMI, KMS, SecurityHub, GuardDuty, AWSConfig, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, RDS, RedShift, and S3 were extracted. An external actor, UserCompanyDeveloper, was inferred from the mention of Axiom SL's team using Terraform, Jenkins, and Ansible for deployment. Edges were meticulously traced from explicit arrows on the diagram. Three primary flows were identified: Deployment & Orchestration (Flow 0) originating from the Axiom SL team, Application Data Processing (Flow 1) focusing on the interactions within the application stack (RDS, RedShift, S3), and Security & Monitoring Interactions (Flow 2) where ECS connects to various security services. Strict adherence to AWS service names, visual connections, and sequential flow was maintained.

nodes.name: Axiom SL DevOps/Developer

nodes.name: RedShift (OLAP)

nodes.name: S3 Bucket
nodes.notes: Amazon S3 is used for warm storage capabilities in conjunction with Redshift Spectrum and provides end-to-end data encryption.

edges.notes: Axiom SL team orchestrates deployments and manages application lifecycle via ECS using tools like Jenkins and Ansible.
Axiom SL team builds CIS-hardened AMIs for the application components.
ECS deploys and manages application containers that interact with the RDS database.
AMI provides the base image for the application deployed to the application stack, including components that interact with RDS.
Application running on ECS interacts with RDS for OLTP data operations.
OLTP data from RDS is processed and moved to Redshift for OLAP.
Redshift queries S3 for warm storage capability using Redshift Spectrum.
Data is read from S3 back to Redshift for Spectrum queries, indicating bi-directional data flow.
ECS integrates with KMS for encryption and key management for application data and resources.
ECS events and configurations are monitored by SecurityHub for security posture management.
ECS activity is monitored by GuardDuty for anomaly detection and threat identification.
ECS configuration changes are tracked by AWS Config for compliance and to trigger automated security responses.
ECS logs and metrics are sent to CloudWatch for operational monitoring and alerting.
API calls made by or to ECS are logged by CloudTrail for auditing and security analysis.
